title: 第19章 青龙石柱第20章 获得功法
content_zh:
张皓旸在踏进混沌塔一层后先是浓郁成实质的灵气瞬间包裹全身，他口中默念混沌造化诀，那浓郁灵气瞬间就向他的身体聚集，由头顶百会处快速进入体内转化成真气流转身体各处。
张皓旸边吸收炼化浓郁灵气边仔细打量混沌塔一层。
混沌塔一层宛如一个巨大宫殿，宫殿高数百丈，宽千丈有余，宫殿古朴恢弘，四周墙壁全是黄色，不，那黄色竟在自动变化，数息时间，混沌塔一层四周黄色的墙壁在张皓旸进入后竟是缓缓变成黑白相间之色，黑色在下，白色在上，左侧墙壁的白色空间东侧上方有一轮大日日出东方、阳光普照；右侧墙壁的黑色空间西侧上方有一轮皎洁明月，挥洒银色光辉。
难道自此时起，混沌塔就开始根据进入修者的个人情况进行相应变化，如目前的日升月恒暗合兴盛、希望之意，这令张皓旸诧异无比！
至此，混沌塔一层除四周颜色、景物发生变化外，其他还没有出现让张皓旸选择的功法或宝物。
他继续向一层里面走去，只见在一层四周各有一根金色的巨大石柱，它们分立东西南北四个方向。
每一根金色石柱都有成人环抱粗细，东侧金色石柱之上雕刻一条龙头朝上的青龙，青龙角似鹿、头似驼、眼似兔、项似蛇、腹似蜃、鳞似鲤、爪似鹰、掌似虎、耳似牛，通体青色，栩栩如生、神态庄严、威武霸气，只见青龙盘旋在石柱之上，脚踏祥云，有直冲云霄之势。
青龙五行主木。
西侧金色石柱之上雕刻一只雪白猛虎，白虎威猛雄壮，头部略小、嘴巴宽大、牙齿锋利，双眼如同两颗璀璨的明珠，透露出锐利杀伐的目光；白虎四肢矫健有力，四脚皆为五爪，尾巴长而粗壮，四根巨大石柱上分别雕刻栩栩如生的青龙、白虎、朱雀、玄武四大神兽图案，石柱上的青龙、白虎、朱雀、玄武四神兽周围布满星辰，不断闪烁，耀眼夺目。
白虎五行主金
南侧金色石柱之上雕刻一只身覆火焰的朱雀，朱雀形体似凤凰，鸡之头、燕之颌、蛇之颈、鱼之尾，神奇仪态、百鸟之王；浑身覆盖赤红色羽毛，空中飞舞火光四射，犹如一团永不熄灭的火焰。
朱雀五行主火。
北侧金色石柱之上雕刻一只由青龟和赤蛇组合成的玄武。
玄武龟蛇同体，蛇身龟尾、龟首蛇颈、四足龟爪，背上有九个龟壳。
龟背黑色，有一根长长的龙颈，头和尾巴均是蛇的样子，玄武五行主水。
四根金色石柱耸立在混沌塔一层，每一根金色石柱都散发着金色光芒，四根金色石柱的底部有一根似有若无的金色光束在中间位置联通形成一个金色光球，散发出耀眼的光芒。
张皓旸在将混沌塔一层内的景象基本了解后，他得出一个结论，宽大的一层混沌塔空间内，除四根石柱外就没有其他的东西，他推测石老所说的功法和宝物应该就在刻有四大神兽的金色石柱之上。
张皓旸看着面前的青龙、白虎、朱雀、玄武四根金色石柱。
青龙位于东方，东方为尊，据传青龙守护这片天地之间的界限，那就先去青龙金色石柱试试。
张皓旸首先走向雕刻有青龙神兽的金色石柱，在距离青龙金色石柱大约有三尺左右时，张皓旸竟无法再前进分毫，他有些诧异的看向青龙金色石柱。

就在此时突然有一道龙吟在他的脑际响起，紧接着就有一道恢弘的声音传来：“青龙神殿，存放炼体武技，来者有三次机会，但只可选择一种武技。
请做好准备，九息时间后开始！”
话音未落，只见雕刻着青龙神兽的金色石柱突然金光闪烁，随即金色石柱释放出一团白光将张皓旸的身体包裹，张皓旸一开始还想挣扎，但是身处白光之内的张皓旸不但未有任何不适，还有种被阳光照耀全身的温暖舒服之感。
于是他就放弃挣扎，任凭那团白光包裹住自己，静静等待着九息时间过后锻体武技的出现。
奇异的一幕出现，张皓旸等待的锻体武技尚未出现，被白光包裹的他的身体则是消失当场，下一刻他就出现一个奇异的空间内，空间内悬浮着无数个白色光团，每个光团都在闪烁，犹如夜空的星星。
张皓旸仔细查看光团，他竟然发现在每一个闪烁的白色光团内竟然都有一本武技功法。
看到这里，张皓旸内心狂喜，他暗暗发誓一定要找到一本属于自己的功法。
张皓旸缓缓闭上双眼，收敛心神，平复一下激动的心情。
下一刻，他将神识外放，将注意力全部集中在那些白色光团之上。
就在他释放神识的一瞬间，那些白色光团竟然都动了起来，速度非常之快，犹如电光火石般，在他面前一闪而过。
一个白色光团、两个白色光团，瞬间就有数个光团在他面前一闪而过。
下一刻，又一个白色光团向他飞来，此时张皓旸释放的神识竟是突然颤动一下，他知道这个光团应该与他有些缘分，于是他双眼立即睁开，右手直接向那白色光团抓去。
光团入手并无任何感觉，他根本无法感觉到白色光团的存在，但是却有一本古朴书籍出现在他的右手之中，一团小字浮现在眼前：“凝血炼体法，黄级武技。
需用一百只三阶妖兽之血不断浸泡身体，吸取妖兽血液精华，历经九次淬炼、锻体，方可入门。”
此种武技需要使用一百只三阶妖兽的鲜血，用其血浸泡身体。
需要一百只三阶妖兽的鲜血，以他目前的筑基境一层的修为去斩杀三阶妖兽，三阶妖兽可是筑基境的妖兽，他目前的主要对敌手段主要是力量，妖兽本就擅长力量，因此他要去斩杀一百只三阶妖兽难度可想而知！
即便是斩杀了一百只三阶妖兽如何收集妖兽鲜血也是极为麻烦的问题。
另外此功法需要用妖兽鲜血浸泡身体，只是闭眼想一下都感到极为血腥。
张皓旸没有犹豫直接将此功法放弃，被丢弃的凝血炼体功法古朴书籍在离开张皓旸右手的瞬间就又变成一个白色光团，一闪而过。

content_en:
After Zhang Haoyang stepped into the first floor of the Chaos Tower, his whole body was instantly enveloped by the rich spiritual energy. He silently recited the Chaos Creation Technique, and the rich spiritual energy immediately gathered around his body. It quickly entered the body from the Baihui point above his head and transformed into true energy that circulated throughout his body.
Zhang Haoyang carefully looked at the first floor of the Chaos Tower while absorbing and refining the rich spiritual energy.
The first floor of the Chaos Tower is like a huge palace. The palace is hundreds of feet high and more than a thousand feet wide. The palace is simple and magnificent, and the walls around it are all yellow. No, the yellow color is changing automatically. After a few breaths, the yellow walls around the first floor of the Chaos Tower changed after Zhang Haoyang entered. It slowly turned into black and white, with black at the bottom and white at the top. Above the white space on the left wall on the east side, there was a big sun rising in the east, and the sun was shining all over it; on the right wall, on the west side of the black space, there was a bright moon, shining with silver brilliance.
Could it be that from this time on, the Chaos Tower began to change accordingly according to the personal situation of the cultivator. For example, the current sun rising and the moon always coincide with the meaning of prosperity and hope. This surprised Zhang Haoyang!
So far, apart from the changes in the surrounding colors and scenery on the first floor of the Chaos Tower, there are no other techniques or treasures for Zhang Haoyang to choose.
He continued walking into the first floor and saw a huge golden stone pillar around the first floor. They were separated in four directions: east, west, north and south.
Each golden stone pillar is surrounded by adults. On the east side of the golden stone pillar is carved a blue dragon with its head facing upward. The green dragon's horns are like a deer, its head is like a camel, its eyes are like a rabbit, its neck is like a snake, its belly is like a mirage, its scales are like a carp, its claws are like an eagle, its palms are like a tiger, and its ears are like an ox.
Qinglong is the main wood of the Five Elements.
A snow-white tiger is carved on the golden stone pillar on the west side. The white tiger is powerful and majestic. It has a slightly smaller head, a wide mouth, sharp teeth, and its eyes are like two bright pearls, revealing a sharp killing gaze. The white tiger's limbs are strong and strong, and all four feet have five claws. , the tail is long and thick, and the four huge stone pillars are carved with lifelike patterns of the four mythical beasts of Qinglong, White Tiger, Suzaku, and Xuanwu. The four mythical beasts of Qinglong, White Tiger, Suzaku, and Xuanwu on the stone pillars are surrounded by stars, which are constantly flashing and dazzling.
White Tiger Five Elements Main Gold
On the golden stone pillar on the south side, a red bird covered in flames is carved. The shape of the red bird is like a phoenix, with the head of a chicken, the jaws of a swallow, the neck of a snake, and the tail of a fish. It has a magical appearance and is the king of birds. It is covered with red feathers, and the fire is flying in the air, like an eternal flame.
The Five Elements of Suzaku govern fire.
On the north side, a golden stone pillar is carved with a basalt composed of a green turtle and a red snake.
The basalt turtle has the same body as a snake, with a snake body and turtle tail, a turtle head and a snake neck, four legs and claws, and nine turtle shells on its back.
The turtle has a black back, a long dragon neck, and a snake-like head and tail. The five elements of Xuanwu govern water.
Four golden stone pillars stand on the first floor of the Chaos Tower. Each golden stone pillar exudes golden light. At the bottom of the four golden stone pillars, there is a seemingly invisible golden beam that connects in the middle to form a golden ball of light, emitting a dazzling light.
After Zhang Haoyang had a basic understanding of the scene on the first floor of the Chaos Tower, he came to the conclusion that there was nothing else except four stone pillars in the large space of the first floor of the Chaos Tower. He speculated that the skills and treasures mentioned by Mr. Shi should be on the golden stone pillars engraved with the four sacred beasts.
Zhang Haoyang looked at the four golden stone pillars in front of him: Qinglong, White Tiger, Suzaku, and Xuanwu.
Qinglong is located in the east, and the east is the most respected. It is said that Qinglong protects the boundary between heaven and earth, so let's try the Qinglong golden stone pillar first.
Zhang Haoyang first walked towards the golden stone pillar engraved with the green dragon mythical beast. When he was about three feet away from the green dragon golden stone pillar, Zhang Haoyang could not move any further. He looked at the green dragon golden stone pillar in surprise.
At this moment, suddenly there was a dragon roar in his headSuddenly, a majestic voice came: "Qinglong Temple stores body refining martial arts. Visitors have three chances, but they can only choose one martial skill.
Please be prepared, it will start in nine breaths! "
Before he finished speaking, the golden stone pillar engraved with the green dragon beast suddenly flashed with golden light, and then the golden stone pillar released a ball of white light that enveloped Zhang Haoyang's body. Zhang Haoyang wanted to struggle at first, but Zhang Haoyang, who was inside the white light, not only did not feel any discomfort, but also felt a warm and comfortable feeling of being illuminated by the sun.
So he gave up struggling and allowed the white light to wrap around him, quietly waiting for the physical training skill to appear after nine breaths.
A strange scene appeared. The body-building martial arts that Zhang Haoyang was waiting for had not yet appeared. His body wrapped in white light disappeared on the spot. The next moment, he appeared in a strange space. There were countless white light groups suspended in the space. Each light group was twinkling, like stars in the night sky.
Zhang Haoyang carefully examined the light groups, and he discovered that there was a martial arts book inside each flashing white light group.
Seeing this, Zhang Haoyang was ecstatic, and he secretly vowed to find a book of his own exercises.
Zhang Haoyang slowly closed his eyes, calmed down his excitement, and calmed down his excitement.
The next moment, he released his consciousness and focused all his attention on those white light groups.
The moment he released his spiritual consciousness, those white light groups started to move very fast, like lightning and flint, flashing in front of him.
One white light group, two white light groups, and several light groups flashed in front of him in an instant.
The next moment, another white light ball flew towards him. At this time, Zhang Haoyang's consciousness suddenly trembled. He knew that this light ball should have some fate with him, so he immediately opened his eyes and grabbed the white light ball with his right hand.
He didn't feel anything when he held the light ball. He couldn't feel the existence of the white light ball at all, but an ancient book appeared in his right hand, and a group of small words appeared in front of his eyes: "Blood coagulation and body refining method, yellow-level martial arts."
It is necessary to continuously soak the body with the blood of a hundred third-level monster beasts, absorb the blood essence of the monster beasts, and undergo nine times of tempering and forging before one can enter. "
This kind of martial arts requires the use of the blood of a hundred third-level monsters, soaking the body with its blood.
He needs the blood of a hundred third-level monsters. With his current cultivation level of the first level of the Foundation Establishment Realm, he needs to kill the third-order monsters. The third-order monsters are the monsters of the Foundation Establishment Realm. His current main method of fighting enemies is strength. Monsters are good at strength, so you can imagine how difficult it is for him to kill a hundred third-order monsters!
Even if one hundred third-level monsters are killed, how to collect the blood of the monsters is still an extremely troublesome problem.
In addition, this technique requires soaking the body with the blood of monsters. Just thinking about it with your eyes closed makes you feel extremely bloody.
Zhang Haoyang gave up this technique without hesitation. The discarded ancient book on blood coagulation and body training techniques turned into a white ball of light and flashed past the moment it left Zhang Haoyang's right hand.
